notes: The video overlay finally sits where it should: the @handle, title and audio line now ride clearly above the bottom bar instead of hiding behind it (an old style rule was silently overriding the raised position), the action buttons and progress bar moved up with them, the info block at the bottom is tighter, and the spinning audio disc is tucked firmly into the bottom-right corner. Videos now play at 70% volume instead of full blast. Likes stay in sync everywhere — like something in the feed and the count and heart update on your profile, the Liked tab, Discover and audio pages at the same moment. The Messages badge no longer flashes a fake '3' on launch; it only appears once your real unread count loads. And updates are locked down for real this time: checking for updates can never install one by itself — the Settings button turns into an Update button you tap when you're ready, the banner's Update button is the other way, and the background helper can no longer swap in newer files on its own.
